visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Opening shot inside a spacious hotel suite featuring two twin beds with white linens and grey runners. The room has polished wooden floors and a large sliding glass door opening to a balcony overlooking a vast, misty lake surrounded by mountains. The lighting is soft and natural from the overcast sky. (2) A woman with dark hair tied back appears in a selfie shot, smiling broadly and flashing a peace sign. She is wearing a pink and white striped baseball-style jacket. Behind her, the hazy blue lake and distant green hills are visible through the large window. (3) The camera shifts to an outdoor infinity pool, its surface perfectly still, merging with the horizon of the lake. Tall green trees frame the view, and a small pier extends into the water under a cloudy sky. (4) A wide pan of the interior reveals dark wood-paneled walls and ceilings, giving a traditional Chinese aesthetic. Several people are seen sitting on a low sofa near a window, while the camera moves past a dark wooden desk. (5) The shot returns to the balcony view, showing a grey, overcast sky and the calm waters of Sun Moon Lake. The balcony has a glass railing, stone accents, and a small wooden table. (6) An elderly woman with short grey hair is shown from behind, sitting in a wheelchair and looking out through the large glass window at the scenic lake. (7) A white-tiled bathroom is shown, featuring a specialized seat and grab bars for accessibility. The lighting is bright and clean, with a potted orchid adding a decorative touch. (8) The woman reappears in a mirror selfie, cradling a baby in her arms while wearing a pink and white jacket in a well-lit hotel bathroom. (9) A long wooden balcony features a large ornamental red ceramic vase standing on a pedestal, with a daybed and low table positioned for relaxation. (10) A fast-paced montage displays various high-end foods: a chef in a blue-gloved hand and black mask preparing seaweed wraps, raw beef slices on a wooden board, fresh clams in bamboo steamers, and a glass display filled with various colorful tarts, macarons, and green tea cakes. (11) A final selfie of the woman concludes the video as she talks directly to the camera, smiling and gesturing with her hand against the backdrop of the hotel room.
